prompt:

Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — submissive (a.服从的，顺从的): One adult accepts another person's firm instruction with a lowered gaze and quiet nod, hands together; obedient manner, no humiliation.
TOP RIGHT — feline (a.猫的): A cat with whiskers, triangular ears and raised curved tail stands beside a small outline of a cat paw; unmistakably cat-related.
BOTTOM LEFT — independence (n.独立，独立性): An adult solves a practical task alone with their own tools while an offered helping hand remains unused, calm capable posture.
BOTTOM RIGHT — windowsill (n.窗槛，窗台): A close view of a window with a broad horizontal windowsill, small potted plant resting on the sill; sill highlighted blue.
review_notes: Reviewed compliant posture, complete cat/paw cue, independent practical work without accepting help and blue windowsill. All subjects readable and contained.
